ownerReports.issue: Qwen3.5-397B crashes with synthetic prompt shapes; stable only with tuned prompts (300k ctx at np=1, 200k at np=2). Same repo throughput: Qwen3 30B MoE Q4_K_M tg128 86.1, pp512 1,142; Qwen3-Coder-Next 80B Q4_K_M tg128 42.7; MiniMax M2.5 Q3_K_M (101.76 GB) tg128 32.8; Nemotron-3 Nano 30B MXFP4 tg128 61.5, on Fedora 43, kernel 6.18.x, ROCm 7.0 nightly, 128GB. Split between EVO-X2 and GTR9 Pro not stated.
Crashes under heavy GPU or full load (at least 2 reports) and integrated NIC not detected after crash until power cycle (1 report); Ubuntu ~2 min boot. USB Ethernet or Wi-Fi avoids crashes.
HDMI black screen after login on KDE and Hyprland from kernel 7.2.3 onward (7.2.5, 7.2.6 also); 7.1.8 works. One reporter.
gfx ring timeout freeze/blackout under light GL load (Ubuntu kernel 7.0.0-15.15, BIOS 3.0.3). amdgpu.gpu_recovery=1 only enables recovery.
Kernel 6.18.x/6.19.x amdgpu hangs, GPU reset loops and freezes; workaround amdgpu.cwsr_enable=0 or kernel 6.15-6.17. Mostly laptops (gfx1150); applies to Strix Halo hardware only by inference.
Owners report gpt-oss-20B 22 t/s (LM Studio) vs 77 t/s (Vulkan); 70B dense 5-7 t/s; gpt-oss-120B 22 t/s at Q4 with 30k ctx by one user, 50-60 t/s by others; 215 GB/s bandwidth cited as the limit.

evo-x2-64.summary: Three reviews cover the 64GB unit or the family (Notebookcheck 64GB, Wccftech 64GB, 3DTested snippet). Memory is soldered; GPU can take up to 48GB, 16GB stays with the system (Notebookcheck ES). The ServeTheHome 70B Q6_K test needed 50GB+ VRAM and was run on 128GB, so it would not fit. No independent LLM tok/s measurement exists for 64GB in what I opened. Noise ranges from 41-43 dBA (STH, 128GB) to 'annoying' at high TDP (Wccftech) to 50 dBA (3DTested snippet), not reconciled. Temps exceed 85C at full load (Wccftech) vs 'cool and quiet' (Notebookcheck).
commonIssues: Fan noise at high TDP modes

evo-x2-128.summary: STH measured 8-14W idle, 147-160W and 41-43 dBA on 70B Q6_K, 3.7-3.8 t/s on that dense model; owner GitHub data shows MoE models in the 30-86 t/s range on Linux/ROCm.

evo-x3.summary: One hands-on Notebookcheck review (gaming/CPU focus, 66C gaming, 83C CPU stress, ~147W gaming, $3,799.99) and one sponsored L1T post (8B models only, ~38 t/s hybrid). No independent noise, idle-power or large-model data found.

ms-s1-max-64.summary: Only news coverage; no hands-on 64GB measurements found. Known: $2,639 vs $3,199, no 96GB GPU allocation.

ms-s1-max-128.summary: Conflicting noise: STH up to 43 dBA at 1 m, Notebookcheck snippet up to 48 dB, NASCompares 51-53 dBA load and 39-41 idle. Power: STH ~120W AI, 220W synthetic; Notebookcheck snippet 236W; NASCompares 141-158 GPU-heavy. LLM: Akita 43.2 t/s Qwen3.5-35B, 19.2 t/s Qwen3.5-122B, 30-35 t/s gpt-oss-120B (snippet).

bosgame-m5.summary: STH: 160-170W max, familiar AXB35 platform, cheapest 128GB. Owner HDMI black-screen on CachyOS kernel 7.2.x.

beelink-gtr9-pro.summary: STH: idle 16-25W, 39-41 dBA heavy AI, 31.41 t/s gpt-oss 120B; E610 10GbE instability causing crashes in some units.

framework-desktop.summary: PCWorld Editors' Choice, quiet; Phoronix snippet 100-104W average. Owner threads show kernel-dependent gfx1151 ring timeouts.
commonIssues: amdgpu ring timeouts/hangs on some kernels

gaps: No independent hands-on LLM tok/s for a 64GB EVO-X2 or 64GB MS-S1 MAX found. The STH 70B Q6_K test needs 50GB+ VRAM and used 128GB.
No independent noise dB or idle-watt measurement of the EVO-X3 found; Tom's Hardware and TechRadar EVO-X3 pieces were news or paywalled.
Notebookcheck English pages returned 403 (EVO-X2, EVO-X3, MS-S1 main review); Spanish/Russian mirrors used and extractions lacked dB/idle figures. The MS-S1 48 dB/236 W numbers are snippet-only.
Phoronix Framework pages returned 403 on two attempts; its numbers are snippet-only.

TechRadar MS-S1 MAX (membership wall), TechRadar Bosgame (not opened), Liliputing, Tom's Hardware reviews, TechPowerUp, Chips and Cheese, Hardware Canucks, Ars Technica: no usable hands-on review opened.
STH EVO-X2 page 2 not opened; STH Bosgame and GTR9 power/noise pages not fully read; Guru3D Bosgame power/noise pages (5, 17) not opened.

Owner defect reports: no Reddit, Trustpilot or GMKtec-owner threads were retrievable. Searches returned no EVO-X2 coil-whine, DOA or SSD reports, so no counts exist for those. The ownerReports above are mostly Strix Halo kernel/firmware issues on other brands.
Minisforum 'BIOS update issues' came from a Japanese blog snippet (gadgetzamurai.jp), not opened.
MiniPCLab, runaihome and dev.to pages are low-quality aggregators; MiniPCLab MS-S1 page contains factual errors and was excluded from measurements.
STH MS-S1 byline (Ryan Smith) came from the extraction; verify before citing.
